findings: Original ReadTx includes Context/Commit/Done plus package-private methods; embedding the genuine interface retains the private methods. WithValue(original Context) preserves original ctxKeyTx. Actual DB getReadTx selects noOpTx for that live same-instance reader; it does not acquire a replacement reader.

Counter Commit calls actual original Commit before recording actual Done and exact error. The actual readTx Commit releases the read connection and pool before return; Done compares the captured version.

Original Query Limit/Offset/Sort/IndexHint signatures match wrapper delegation; Iter delegates exact ctx. Embedded Next, delegated Doc/Err/Close preserve original results and errors. FindId and FindIdWithParser likewise observe after the original result without replacing data.
Original anyenc Object.Visit only enumerates pairs. Recorder clones original encoded row and field bytes, does not mutate the row, and reports errors/outside-context/after-commit observations.

Full unchanged observer fills SpaceID, NativeKey, account/ACL identity and target/archive IDs before its two snapshots. Final comparison returns that same result with exact ErrFixedSchemaChanged; early wrapped errors are not admitted as the retry case.

V7 requires exactly two committed/done snapshots without trace/read errors, positive coverage for original state/settings/schema/counter/archive/heads/ACL rows, exact counter bytes before/inside/after, and unchanged original runtime/account/ACL scope. Retry requires an actual recorded row difference plus exact final Changed result, at most three attempts under one 10-second context.
V7 uses only existing tracedSchemaSpace/tracedSchemaStorage delegation for this recorder; the separate synthetic V6 fault injector is not selected in observeStableCounter.
